🤖 Spawning agent...Here's a full analysis of the **AI Disaster Management System**:

## Overview
A full-stack final-year engineering project for reporting and managing disaster events in real-time.

## Tech Stack
| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| **Backend** | Java 17, Spring Boot 3.2, Spring Security (JWT), Spring Data JPA, H2 (in-memory), Maven |
| **Frontend** | React 18, Vite 5, React Router 6, Axios, Recharts, react-hot-toast |

## Architecture
```
React (5173) ──proxy──► Spring Boot (8080) ──► H2 (in-memory)
```
- Vite proxies `/api/*` to backend, avoiding CORS issues in dev

## Features Implemented
- **Auth**: JWT-based registration & login (with BCrypt)
- **RBAC**: Two roles — `USER` and `ADMIN`
- **Disaster CRUD**: Report, list, update status, delete
- **Status lifecycle**: PENDING → ASSIGNED → IN_PROGRESS → RESOLVED
- **Dashboards**: Stats cards, severity bar chart, status pie chart (Recharts)
- **Admin panel**: Manage all disasters, update status inline, delete
- **Search/filter**: Client-side filtering by type, location, status, reporter
- **Responsive CSS**: Pure CSS with custom properties & breakpoints at 768px and 576px
- **Seed data**: 2 users (admin/admin123, user/user123) and 4 sample disasters

## Backend Structure (`backend/`)
- **Entities**: `User`, `Disaster`, `Role` (enum), `DisasterStatus` (enum)
- **DTOs**: 6 request/response classes with validation annotations
- **Security**: Custom `JwtUtils`, `JwtAuthFilter`, `UserDetailsImpl`, `UserDetailsServiceImpl`
- **Controllers**: `AuthController` (`/api/auth/*`), `DisasterController` (`/api/disasters/*`)
- **Services**: `AuthService`, `DisasterService`
- **Exceptions**: `ResourceNotFoundException` + `@RestControllerAdvice` for consistent error JSON
- 5 API endpoints (register, login, create/list/update/delete disasters)

## Frontend Structure (`frontend/`)
- **Context**: `AuthContext` manages login/register/logout, persists JWT in localStorage
- **Routing**: 7 routes with `ProtectedRoute` guard (auth check + admin-only)
- **Pages**: Login, Register, UserDashboard, DisasterList, ReportDisaster, AdminDashboard
- **API layer**: Axios instance with request interceptor (attaches JWT) & 401 response interceptor (redirects to login)
- **State**: No Redux — each page fetches its own data independently

## What's Missing (Planned Enhancements per README)
AI damage prediction, AI resource optimization, SMS/email alerts, Google Maps, live tracking, weather API, satellite imagery, drone monitoring, hospital/shelter/volunteer management, cloud deployment.
